name: From All Sides: Spatial Sound Forum 2026
description: Catalyst's annual Spatial Sound Forum brings together artists, educators, students and the wider Berlin music and sound community. Through performances, listening sessions, workshops, talks and installations, the programme explores spatial sound as a practice shaped by bodies, rooms and shared attention. The 2026 edition is framed by 'Gradients of Ma', focusing on intervals, pauses and quiet as active space.
